property_summary: For every call, the reference contract's owner() returns the address that was set during construction/ownership transfer (initially the deployer), whereas the mutant always returns address(0) so there exists some caller for which the returned owner address differs (the rule: owner() == deployer address), which the mutant violates.
change_summary: owner() now returns the zero address instead of the stored _owner, changing returned value observable by external callers.
